name: Zhongyuan Environmental Protection Co., Ltd.
summary: Zhongyuan Environmental Protection Co., Ltd. is a significant Chinese enterprise specializing in the design, construction, operation, and ongoing management of a wide array of environmental and public utility initiatives across the People's Republic of China. Its comprehensive business activities extend to crucial areas such as: Water Management: This includes urban water supply, drainage systems, advanced wastewater treatment, the utilization of reclaimed water, and sludge processing. Energy Production: The company is involved in generating and supplying thermal energy, as well as producing electricity through waste-to-energy processes, wind power, and photovoltaic (solar) power. Technical Services & Engineering: Zhongyuan provides extensive water-related technical research and development, manufactures and sells specialized equipment, offers engineering design and general contracting, project management, expert engineering consulting, and technical support. Urban & Ecological Development: Its work further encompasses constructing municipal infrastructure, undertaking ecological engineering and restoration projects, cultivating seedlings, designing green spaces, and providing landscaping engineering and maintenance services. The company's headquarters are located in Zhengzhou, China, and it operates as an affiliate of the Zhengzhou Public Utilities Investment and Development Group Co., Ltd.
